question: Given the symbolic definitions: P + Q means P is the mother of Q; P - Q means P is the brother of Q; P * Q means P is the father of Q. Which of the following expressions conclusively establishes that "M is the nephew of N"?
options: N - K * M (where M is male)
explanation: In "N - K * M", N is the brother of K, and K is the father of M. Hence K is N's brother, and K's son M is N's nephew.

explanation: Brian Kernighan's algorithm: `n & (n - 1)` removes the rightmost set bit in O(1) time. Used to count total 1s in O(number of set bits).
